Mt kaukau wellington 154kph, Brothers Island Marlborough 151kph, Cape reinga northland 133kph, New Plymouth airport taranaki 117kph, Kelburn wellington 110kph.

post.text:
🍃 Its been a stormy night across much of the country, with more to come 🌧️

‼️ Wind gusts have not yet peaked for the centre of the country, with the strongest wind gusts expected later this morning. Conditions will start to ease later this afternoon and into the evening.

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
